column1: # rules.tsv: which files of a source repository go into this repository.
# make-sources-list.sh reads this file. It writes sources.tsv.
# - source_id: a name in sources.local.conf (the local clone and the path prefix).
# - pattern: an extended regular expression. It matches the path relative to the source prefix.
# A file is selected when one include pattern matches and no exclude pattern matches.
# The destination is "pipeline/" plus the relative path, so relative paths in the scripts stay valid.
# S1: sources and rosters (the scripts, the lists, the method notes).
# S2: resolve and pool, the v2 supplement, the GitLab extension.
# S4: filter, and the DP8L licence audit.
# S5 and S6: evidence and labels.
# S7: run manifests, parts, run scripts, post-fix, merge, tests.
# S7: the EC2 runner scripts (copies of the scripts that ran the dataset build, see runner/README.md).
# The runner kits of the later runs (copies added on 2026-10-25, the same token rule): the merge of
# the 5,000+ layer, the runs, the merge and the links of the 1,000-4,999 layer (machines A and B,
# the extra machines, x2, x3), the path-fix rerun and the organisation columns of version 1.
# The include above selects them. These lines name them, so that a review sees each kit.
# Exclusions: logs, run output, caches, one-shot work files.
# Environment files hold local values (for example the volume ids of machine A). Never copy them.
# ctp (the runner) at the commit that the dataset build ran. tools.lock pins the whole tool.
# These copies are for reading: the column contract, the validation, the file mask,
# the manifest builder, the firm tables, the dependency pin and the runner document.
# The cregit fork at 57551d7. These files have the same git blob ids in all five cregit
# commits of the dataset build (95cdc88, 9ccead6, 1f17663, 57551d7, 23e4ccb). flake.nix
# builds srcML from nix/srcml.nix and compares the result with the build store path.
